title: Commitment-Based Knowledge Distillation: Statistical Certification and Optimistic Verification for Trust-Minimized Model Serving — Reproduction Package
description: Reproducibility repository for the earlier commitment-based knowledge-distillation working paper, preserving its statistical-certificate, optimistic-dispute and EVM-arbitration component prototypes. The frozen Baseline V1 is identified by the version-specific DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23644783. A distinct finite-population fidelity-auditing study now has its own repository at https://github.com/Antoniorjr4/auditable-teacher-student-fidelity and independent preprint DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23851318. The audit folder and initial mixed-repository release retained here are historical provenance, not the preferred citation or active home of that study. Code and third-party licenses remain as stated in the repository.
